neighbours.label: In descriptions of apps and digital tools: the function word (a / an / the / via / with) that introduces the feature or means by which the app does something ('…with a [quick tap]', 'via [Bluetooth]'); quiet on the same frames about non-digital activities
fire: This free app helps you learn guitar chords and checks your playing with a built-in tuner.
The budgeting app tracks every purchase and warns you about overspending through a push notification.
With this weather app you can follow storms in real time using the interactive radar map.
The language app teaches new vocabulary every day and tests your memory with a short quiz.
Our parking app finds an empty space nearby and guides you there via turn-by-turn navigation.
The recipe app scans your fridge contents and suggests dinners with a single swipe.
This reading app lets parents record bedtime stories and share them with relatives over the cloud.
The hiking app records your route and lets friends follow your progress via a live link.
quiet: My uncle taught me guitar chords and checked my playing with a wooden metronome.
The old shopkeeper tracked every purchase and warned us about overspending through a stern look.
With these binoculars the sailors could follow storms from the deck using the brass compass.
The village teacher taught new vocabulary every day and tested our memory with a short poem.
Our neighbor found an empty stall at the market and led the horse there via the back lane.
The cook looked over the pantry shelves and suggested dinners with a tired shrug.
The grandparents wrote down bedtime stories and shared them with relatives over the holidays.
The shepherd marked his route with stones and let his sons follow his progress via a mountain path.

notes: Card: ' a', ' an', ' the', ' via' right before a tech feature in app blurbs; output promotes ' feature', ' app', ' maps', ' based'. Probes: app sentences 0.36-0.86, same frames about a grandmother / gardener 0.01. Near misses keep the 'with a / via / using the' frame in non-digital settings.
